_note: Hand-derived from the recorded article text in listing.html. The Forex/Crypto table
gives eight instruments against one dated column, 'Friday - July 3rd'; seven of them
close at 20:00 and BRENT alone at 20:30, so they group into exactly two events.
The year comes from the futures line in the same post, '7/03/2026'. 3 July 2026 is
stated_utc_offset is '+03:00' on both, copied from the '(gmt+3)' the article prints on
every row. This source sets require_stated_offset, so that copied offset is the ONLY
thing that makes these events publishable — E8's server clock runs UTC+3 from the end
of March to the beginning of November, which is no IANA zone, so there is nothing safe
to fall back to. An E8 row without an offset is rejected, not guessed.
